# Darmi

> Darmi is a privacy-first iOS food and symptom tracker for people living with IBS
> (irritable bowel syndrome). It turns health records into patterns users can review
> and structured data they can bring to a doctor. No account is required; health
> records are stored on the user's own device.

- **Website:** https://darmi.app/
- **Download:** https://apps.apple.com/us/app/darmi-ibs-food-symptom-tracker/id6759197247
- **Platform:** iOS
- **Price:** Freemium, with optional monthly, yearly or lifetime Pro.
- **Contact:** darmi.feedback@gmail.com

## What it tracks

Darmi records **meals, symptoms, stool type, and stress**. Stool uses the Bristol
Stool Scale. Darmi does not track mood.

## What it does

- **Fast logging.** Quick Picks surface frequent foods as shortcuts. Users can add
  new foods freely, attach locally stored meal photos, or start from a Home Screen
  widget.
- **Possible food associations.** Key Findings look for foods that repeatedly appear
  in the six hours before symptoms begin, then compare those records with foods on
  symptom-free days. Detail views summarize associations across the selected period;
  they do not treat a single episode as proof of a trigger.
- **Better-tolerated foods.** Darmi highlights foods that may be better tolerated,
  without claiming that a food is universally or conclusively safe.
- **Symptom details and trends.** Compare symptom days with the previous equal-length
  period and, when there is enough data, compare average severity. Users can view
  daily or weekly trends, related food statistics, and jump from daily snapshots to
  that day's records. Free includes 7 days; Pro adds 14, 30 and 90 days.
- **Calendar view.** A month view of logged health records.
- **Doctor-ready PDF.** Export recent meal, symptom and stool records for review and
  discussion. PDFs do not include stress records, photos or trend charts.

## Privacy model

- No account, sign-up or login.
- Health records are stored locally on the user's device; the app works offline.
- The current released app does not send product-usage analytics events to Darmi
  or to a third-party analytics provider.
- No advertising SDKs.
- Full policy: https://darmi.app/privacy.html

## Languages

English, Deutsch, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, Français, Español, Português.

## Important limitation

Darmi is a tracking and pattern-analysis app, not a diagnostic tool or medical
device. It does not diagnose IBS or prove that a food caused a symptom. It organizes
information for users and healthcare providers to review and discuss.
